about.description: Flash Trade is a perpetual platform on Solana led by Co-Founder & CEO Anas Khader, backed by Solana Ventures, Jump Capital, and ROK Capital. The platform offers stock, commodity, and equity-index perpetuals alongside crypto with up to 500× leverage and a distinctive pool-to-peer liquidity model, with all positions margined and cash-settled in USDC. Pricing is sourced from Pyth Network. Flash Trade unveiled at Breakpoint 2025 a roadmap toward near-zero-latency infrastructure, fully permissionless order books, and broader RWA market expansion.
about.registryInfo: Flash Trade is led by Co-Founder & CEO Anas Khader. The platform is built on Solana and backed by Alameda Research, Solana Ventures, Jump Capital, and ROK Capital. Pricing comes from Pyth Network. Native token: FAF.

fees.revenueNotes: Flash Trade captures open/close fees (~6-8 bps) plus borrow fees from leveraged positions, and counter-party PnL via the FLP liquidity pool (similar to Jupiter Perpetuals/GMX model). Fees distributed to FLP token-holders and stakers.
